# The crombolo command line

<!-- Generated by `bun run cli:spec` from the commands themselves. Do not edit. -->

Every command, its arguments, what it changes, what it prints with `-o json` and how it fails. `clispec.json` beside this file is the same description for a machine, as `crombolo schema` prints it (https://clispec.dev).

Every command also takes:

- `-o, --output <text|json>`: text for people, or JSON for scripts, on stdout;
- `--json`: the same as `-o json`.

## Sites

Create a site, start it, check on it, and describe the command line to a script.

### `crombolo init`

Scaffold a site in the current, empty directory. Each run acts again.

```
crombolo init [--force] [--name <name>] [--next] [--postgres] [--template <template>] [--verbose]
```

| Argument | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--force` | boolean | Scaffold into a directory that is not empty, overwriting its files. |
| `--name` | string | The site's name. |
| `--next` | boolean | Add a Next.js front end in web/, whatever the template. |
| `--postgres` | boolean | Configure Postgres rather than SQLite. |
| `--template` | string | A starter template, or `list`. |
| `--verbose` | boolean | List every file it writes. |

**Output** (bounded, with `-o json`):

- `created` (array of string)
- `templates` (array of object)

**Fails with:** `usage`, `internal`, `not_found`, `refused`.

### `crombolo start`

Boot the site in the current directory. Each run acts again.

```
crombolo start [--keep-admin] [--bundle <bundle>] [--from <from>] [--postgres] [--name <name>] [--no-install] [--allow-missing-media] [--label <label>] [--backup-taken] [--under <under>] [--resolve <resolve>] [--resolve-all <resolve-all>] [--allow-missing-blobs] [--publish] [--no-schema] [--no-files] [--replace-files] [--exclude-people] [--allow-downgrade]
```

| Argument | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--keep-admin` | boolean | Don't touch the administrator's password. |
| `--bundle` | string[] | Apply a bundle's content first, or `.` for this site's own content files; repeatable. |
| `--from` | string | In an empty folder: a site from a whole-site file. |
| `--postgres` | boolean | With --from: configure Postgres. |
| `--name` | string | With --from: the site's name. |
| `--no-install` | boolean | With --from: skip `bun install`. |
| `--allow-missing-media` | boolean | With --from: import media items whose files the file does not carry. |
| `--label` | string | A label for a bundle's import run. |
| `--backup-taken` | boolean | A backup was taken another way: Postgres needs this, or CROMBOLO_PG_DUMP. |
| `--under` | string | Place the bundle under this page. |
| `--resolve` | string[] | Answer a finding: <key>=take-bundle\|keep-local\|skip, or <key>/<property>[@<culture>]=take-bundle\|keep-local. |
| `--resolve-all` | string | Answer every finding the same way. One of `take-bundle`, `keep-local`, `skip`. |
| `--allow-missing-blobs` | boolean | Import media items whose files the bundle does not carry. |
| `--publish` | boolean | Publish what it imports. |
| `--no-schema` | boolean | Decline the schema the bundle carries. |
| `--no-files` | boolean | Decline the views, styles and scripts it carries. |
| `--replace-files` | boolean | Allow replacing files this site has; the originals are kept for a revert. |
| `--exclude-people` | boolean | Leave out the members and users it carries; this site's own are untouched. |
| `--allow-downgrade` | boolean | Apply a site bundle older than one this site applied from the same signer: a deliberate rollback, recorded in the audit log. |

**Output:** stream.

**Fails with:** `usage`, `internal`, `not_found`, `conflict`, `refused`, `unavailable`, `auth`.

### `crombolo status`

What this environment is, and what is wrong with it, without starting it. Changes nothing.

```
crombolo status
```

**Output** (single, with `-o json`):

- `site` (object)
- `database` (object)
- `schema` (object)
- `framework` (object)
- `bundles` (object)
- `content` (object)
- `findings` (object)
- `email` (object)
- `versions` (object)
- `problems` (array of string)

**Fails with:** `usage`, `internal`.

**Outcomes:** `problems_found`.

### `crombolo health`

Run the site's health checks. Changes nothing.

```
crombolo health [--group <group>]
```

| Argument | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--group` | string | Only this group of checks. |

**Output** (bounded, with `-o json`):

- `groups` (array of object)
  - `name` (string)
  - `checks` (array of object)
- `failed` (integer)
- `warnings` (integer)

**Fails with:** `usage`, `internal`, `not_found`.

**Outcomes:** `problems_found`.

### `crombolo generate`

TypeScript for the content types in schema/. Safe to run again: a second run changes nothing more.

```
crombolo generate [--delivery] [--out <out>] [--schema <schema>]
```

| Argument | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--delivery` | boolean | Types for the Delivery API's JSON, for an app; needs --out. |
| `--out` | string | The file to write. |
| `--schema` | string | The schema directory to read, if not this site’s. |

**Output** (single, with `-o json`):

- `wrote` (string)

**Fails with:** `usage`, `internal`, `refused`.

### `crombolo schema`

This CLI described for machines, as a clispec v0.3 document. Changes nothing.

```
crombolo schema
```

**Output** (single, with `-o json`): a JSON document.

**Fails with:** `usage`, `internal`, `not_found`.

### `crombolo schema check`

Check the site's definitions, and what applying them would do to this database. Changes nothing.

```
crombolo schema check [--static]
```

| Argument | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--static` | boolean | Validate the files only, no database. |

**Output** (single, with `-o json`):

- `version` (string)
- `counts` (object)
  - `contentTypes` (integer)
  - `mediaTypes` (integer)
  - `dataTypes` (integer)
  - `languages` (integer)
- `problems` (array of object)
- `classification` (string)
- `findings` (array of object)

**Fails with:** `usage`, `internal`, `not_found`.

**Outcomes:** `problems_found`, `blocked`.

### `crombolo schema export`

Write the database's definitions as schema/ files. Safe to run again: a second run changes nothing more.

```
crombolo schema export
```

**Output** (bounded, with `-o json`):

- `wrote` (array of string)

**Fails with:** `usage`, `internal`.

### `crombolo schema new`

Write a type or data type file, and the view it points at, then apply it. Each run acts again.

```
crombolo schema new <kind> <alias> [--name <name>] [--description <description>] [--icon <icon>] [--at-root] [--element] [--tab <tab>] [--title] [--no-view] [--compose <compose>] [--allow-child <allow-child>] [--vary-by-culture] [--vary-by-segment] [--library] [--list-view] [--list-view-type <list-view-type>] [--editor <editor>] [--max-chars <max-chars>] [--rows <rows>] [--min <min>] [--max <max>] [--step <step>] [--default-on] [--label <label>] [--with-time] [--option <option>] [--multiple] [--allow <allow>] [--block <block>] [--columns <columns>]
```

| Argument | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` | string | What kind of type. One of `content-type`, `media-type`, `member-type`, `data-type`. Required. |
| `alias` | string | The type's alias. Required. |
| `--name` | string | The type's name. |
| `--description` | string | The type's description. |
| `--icon` | string | The type's icon. |
| `--at-root` | boolean | Allow it at the root of the tree. |
| `--element` | boolean | An element type, for blocks. |
| `--tab` | string | The tab its title goes in. |
| `--title` | boolean | Start it with a mandatory title: a content type has one unless a composition does, an element type has none. |
| `--no-view` | boolean | No view: a type nothing renders. |
| `--compose` | string[] | A type it is composed of. |
| `--allow-child` | string[] | A type allowed beneath it. |
| `--vary-by-culture` | boolean | Its content differs by language. |
| `--vary-by-segment` | boolean | Its content differs by segment. |
| `--library` | boolean | It may be created in the Library. |
| `--list-view` | boolean | Show the pages beneath it as a list. |
| `--list-view-type` | string | The list view data type, instead of the default. |
| `--editor` | string | Data types: the editor it uses. One of `textstring`, `textarea`, `rich-text`, `number`, `toggle`, `date`, `dropdown`, `content-picker`, `media-picker`, `element-picker`, `block-list`, `block-grid`. |
| `--max-chars` | string | Data types: the most characters allowed. |
| `--rows` | string | Data types: the rows a text area shows. |
| `--min` | string | Data types: the least allowed (number, items). |
| `--max` | string | Data types: the most allowed (number, items). |
| `--step` | string | Data types: the step between numbers. |
| `--default-on` | boolean | Data types: a toggle starts on. |
| `--label` | string | Data types: a toggle's label. |
| `--with-time` | boolean | Data types: a date with a time of day. |
| `--option` | string[] | Data types: a dropdown choice. |
| `--multiple` | boolean | Data types: more than one may be chosen. |
| `--allow` | string[] | Data types: a type a picker offers. |
| `--block` | string[] | Data types: an element type offered as a block. |
| `--columns` | string | Data types: the columns a block grid has. |

**Output** (single, with `-o json`):

- `created` (array of string)
- `schema` (string)

**Fails with:** `usage`, `internal`, `not_found`, `conflict`, `refused`.

### `crombolo schema purge`

Delete properties retired more than N days ago, with their values. Safe to run again: a second run changes nothing more.

```
crombolo schema purge --older-than <older-than> [--backup-taken]
```

| Argument | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--older-than` | string | How long, in days, a property must have been retired. Required. |
| `--backup-taken` | boolean | A backup was taken another way: Postgres needs this, or CROMBOLO_PG_DUMP. |

**Output** (bounded, with `-o json`):

- `purged` (array of string)
- `backup` (string)
- `changed` (boolean)

**Fails with:** `usage`, `internal`, `not_found`, `refused`.

Rewrite every schema/ file canonically. Safe to run again: a second run changes nothing more.

### `crombolo schema sync`

Apply the site's definitions to its database. Safe to run again: a second run changes nothing more.

```
crombolo schema sync [--force-retire-types]
```

| Argument | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--force-retire-types` | boolean | Retire a type the files no longer have even though content uses it. |

**Output** (single, with `-o json`):

- `action` (string)
- `changed` (boolean)
- `summary` (string)
- `problems` (array of object)

**Fails with:** `usage`, `internal`, `not_found`, `refused`.

### `crombolo types property add`

Add a property to a type. Safe to run again: a second run changes nothing more.

```
crombolo types property add <type> <alias> --type <type> [--name <name>] [--description <description>] [--mandatory] [--tab <tab>] [--kind <kind>] [--dry-run] [--no-apply]
```

| Argument | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | string | The type's alias. Required. |
| `alias` | string | The property's alias. Required. |
| `--type` | string | Its data type. Required. |
| `--name` | string | Its name. |
| `--description` | string | Its description. |
| `--mandatory` | boolean | An editor must fill it in. |
| `--tab` | string | The tab it goes in. |
| `--kind` | string | The kind, when two types share the alias. One of `content`, `element`, `media`, `member`. |
| `--dry-run` | boolean | Say what would change, and change nothing. |
| `--no-apply` | boolean | Change it, and leave applying it to `crombolo types sync`. |

**Output** (single, with `-o json`):

- `type` (string)
- `changed` (boolean)
- `applied` (boolean)
- `findings` (array of string)
- `schema` (string)

**Fails with:** `usage`, `internal`, `not_found`, `refused`.

### `crombolo types property rename`

**Output** (single, with `-o json`):

- `type` (string)

- `findings` (array of string)

## Content and media

Pages, media, the dictionary, domains and the recycle bin.

### `crombolo content block add`

Add a block to a page's block list. Each run acts again.

```
crombolo content block add <page> <property> --type <type> [--alias <alias>] [--set <set>] [--settings-set <settings-set>] [--before <before>] [--after <after>] [--first] [--last] [--culture <culture>] [--publish] [--skip-approval] [--dry-run]
```

| Argument | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `page` | string | The page: a path or a uuid. Required. |
| `property` | string | Its block list or grid property. Required. |
| `--type` | string | The block's element type. Required. |
| `--alias` | string | A name to pick the block out by. |
| `--set` | string[] | A value of the block. |
| `--settings-set` | string[] | A value of the block's settings. |
| `--before` | string | Put it before this block. |
| `--after` | string | Put it after this block. |
| `--first` | boolean | Put it first. |
| `--last` | boolean | Put it last. |
| `--culture` | string | The language the values and name are in, for a page that varies by language. |
| `--publish` | boolean | Publish it too, as `content publish` would. |
| `--skip-approval` | boolean | With --publish: publish without the approval its workflow asks for; audited. |
| `--dry-run` | boolean | Say what would change, and change nothing. |

**Output** (single, with `-o json`):

- `key` (string)
- `path` (string)
- `changed` (boolean)

**Fails with:** `usage`, `internal`, `not_found`, `refused`.

### `crombolo content find`

Find pages by their type, place, dates, state, name, text and values. Changes nothing.

```
crombolo content find [--type <type>] [--name <name>] [--name-match <name-match>] [--text <text>] [--under <under>] [--parent <parent>] [--max-depth <max-depth>] [--created-from <created-from>] [--created-to <created-to>] [--updated-from <updated-from>] [--updated-to <updated-to>] [--state <state>] [--culture <culture>] [--where <where>] [--sort <sort>] [--desc] [--skip <skip>] [--take <take>] [--remote <remote>] [--env <env>]
```

| Argument | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--type` | string[] | A content type, by alias or key. |
| `--name` | string | The page name to match. |
| `--name-match` | string | How --name matches. One of `contains`, `startsWith`, `equals`. Default `contains`. |
| `--text` | string | Words in the page, through the search index. |
| `--under` | string | Only pages below this one. |
| `--parent` | string | Only the children of this page. |
| `--max-depth` | string | How many levels below --under or --parent. |
| `--created-from` | string | Created on or after. |
| `--created-to` | string | Created on or before. |
| `--updated-from` | string | Last saved on or after. |
| `--updated-to` | string | Last saved on or before. |
| `--state` | string[] | Published, draft, changed (published with unpublished changes) or trashed. One of `published`, `draft`, `changed`, `trashed`. |
| `--culture` | string | Names, states and values in this language. |
| `--where` | string[] | A value test: "<alias> <op> [value]", up to five. |
| `--sort` | string | What to order by. One of `name`, `createDate`, `updateDate`, `path`, `sortOrder`. Default `name`. |
| `--desc` | boolean | Newest, last or Z first. |
| `--skip` | integer | How many to skip. Default `0`. |
| `--take` | integer | How many to return. Default `25`. |
| `--remote` | string | Search a hosted site through this remote, signed in as you. |
| `--env` | string | The remote's environment. |

**Output** (bounded, with `-o json`):

- `total` (integer)
- `exact` (boolean)
- `items` (array of object)
  - `id` (string)
  - `name` (string)
  - `path` (array of object)
    - `id` (string)
    - `name` (string)
  - `contentType` (object)
    - `id` (string)
    - `alias` (string)
  - `state` (string)
  - `createDate` (string)
  - `updateDate` (string)

**Fails with:** `usage`, `internal`, `not_found`, `refused`, `unavailable`.

```
crombolo domains list
```

**Output** (bounded, with `-o json`):

- `file` (array of object)
  - `node` (string)
  - `host` (string)
  - `resolved` (string)
  - `missing` (array of string)
  - `culture` (string)
- `bound` (array of object)
  - `node` (string)
  - `host` (string)
  - `culture` (string)

**Fails with:** `usage`, `internal`.

### `crombolo domains set`

Write a page's hostnames to domains.toml and apply it. Safe to run again: a second run changes nothing more.

```
crombolo domains set <page> [--host <host>] [--default-culture <default-culture>]
```

| Argument | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `page` | string | A path, a uuid, or / for the root page. Required. |
| `--host` | string[] | A hostname, with its culture after =; repeatable. |
| `--default-culture` | string | The page's fallback culture. |

**Output** (bounded, with `-o json`):

- `wrote` (string)
- `applied` (array of object)
- `removed` (integer)

**Fails with:** `usage`, `internal`, `not_found`, `refused`.

### `crombolo domains undo`

Put back the file the last write replaced, and apply it. Each run acts again.

```
crombolo domains undo
```

**Output** (bounded, with `-o json`):

- `restored` (string)
- `applied` (array of object)
- `removed` (integer)

**Fails with:** `usage`, `internal`, `not_found`, `refused`.

### `crombolo recycle-bin empty`

Delete what is in the recycle bin, for good. Safe to run again: a second run changes nothing more.

```
crombolo recycle-bin empty [--content] [--media] [--older-than <older-than>] [--yes] [--dry-run]
```

| Argument | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--content` | boolean | Only pages. |
| `--media` | boolean | Only media, with their files. |
| `--older-than` | string | Only what was trashed more than this many days ago. |
| `--yes` | boolean | Don't ask. |
| `--dry-run` | boolean | Say what it would do, and change nothing. |

**Output** (bounded, with `-o json`):

- `items` (array of object)
  - `key` (string)
  - `name` (string)
  - `kind` (string)
  - `trashedAt` (string)
- `kept` (integer)
- `changed` (boolean)

**Fails with:** `usage`, `internal`, `confirmation_required`, `refused`.

## Sites, extensions and remotes

Move a site as a site package, install extensions, and sign in to another environment to pull from and push to.

### `crombolo site apply`

Apply a site package here or to a remote: checked, backed up, one transaction. Safe to run again: a second run changes nothing more.

```
crombolo site apply [<bundle>] [--under <under>] [--resolve <resolve>] [--resolve-all <resolve-all>] [--allow-missing-blobs] [--publish] [--no-schema] [--no-files] [--replace-files] [--exclude-people] [--allow-downgrade] [--label <label>] [--backup-taken] [--dry-run] [--save] [--remote <remote>] [--env <env>] [--structure]
```

| Argument | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `bundle` | string | A site package's directory or .tgz, or `.` for this site's content files. |
| `--under` | string | Place the bundle under this page. |
| `--resolve` | string[] | Answer a finding: <key>=take-bundle\|keep-local\|skip, or <key>/<property>[@<culture>]=take-bundle\|keep-local. |
| `--resolve-all` | string | Answer every finding the same way. One of `take-bundle`, `keep-local`, `skip`. |
| `--allow-missing-blobs` | boolean | Import media items whose files the bundle does not carry. |
| `--publish` | boolean | Publish what it imports. |
| `--no-schema` | boolean | Decline the schema the bundle carries. |
| `--no-files` | boolean | Decline the views, styles and scripts it carries. |
| `--replace-files` | boolean | Allow replacing files this site has; the originals are kept for a revert. |
| `--exclude-people` | boolean | Leave out the members and users it carries; this site's own are untouched. |
| `--allow-downgrade` | boolean | Apply a site bundle older than one this site applied from the same signer: a deliberate rollback, recorded in the audit log. |
| `--label` | string | A label for the run. |
| `--backup-taken` | boolean | A backup was taken another way: Postgres needs this, or CROMBOLO_PG_DUMP. |
| `--dry-run` | boolean | Say what it would do, and change nothing. |
| `--save` | boolean | With --dry-run: write the answers into the package. |
| `--remote` | string | Apply it on this remote instead. |
| `--env` | string | With --remote: the remote's environment. |
| `--structure` | boolean | With --remote, from a site directory: send its schema, views, styles and code too, not its content alone. |

**Output** (single, with `-o json`):

- `runId` (string)
- `bundle` (object)
- `counts` (object)
- `findings` (array of object)
- `outstanding` (integer)
- `backup` (string)
- `published` (integer)
- `saved` (string)
- `remote` (string)

**Fails with:** `usage`, `internal`, `refused`, `auth`, `not_found`, `unavailable`.

**Outcomes:** `blocked`.

### `crombolo site build`

A site package from a site directory: its schema, views, styles, content and code. Safe to run again: a second run changes nothing more.

```
crombolo site build [<dir>] [--template <template>] [--out <out>] [--check] [--public-log] [--sign-with <sign-with>] [--sign] [--name <name>] [--with-media] [--code <code>]
```

| Argument | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `dir` | string | The site directory; this one when left out. |
| `--template` | string | A starter site the CLI ships, instead of a directory. |
| `--out` | string | The directory to write it to. |
| `--check` | boolean | Build it, report its problems, and write nothing. |
| `--public-log` | boolean | Sign from a private repository anyway: Sigstore's public log records its name, workflow, ref and commit. |
| `--sign-with` | string | Sign it with this user key, as a CI job does, rather than the site's own. |
| `--sign` | boolean | Sign it once written, in GitHub Actions: `bundle sign` in the same step. |
| `--name` | string | The site package's name. |
| `--with-media` | boolean | The media files too; left out unless asked. |
| `--code` | string[] | The site's own code, as globs; in place of crombolo.code in its package.json. |

**Output** (single, with `-o json`):

- `id` (string)
- `name` (string)
- `out` (string)
- `nodes` (integer)
- `code` (integer)
- `findings` (array of object)
  - `file` (string)
  - `line` (integer)
  - `code` (string)
  - `message` (string)
- `counts` (object)
  - `content` (integer)
  - `library` (integer)
  - `media` (integer)

**Fails with:** `usage`, `internal`, `not_found`, `refused`.

**Outcomes:** `problems_found`.

### `crombolo site deploy`

Deploy a site directory to a remote: build, check, apply its structure, content and code, restart. Each run acts again.

```
crombolo site deploy [<dir>] --remote <remote> [--env <env>] [--publish] [--label <label>] [--yes] [--no-restart] [--public-log] [--sign-with <sign-with>] [--sign]
```

| Argument | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `dir` | string | The site directory; this one when left out. |
| `--remote` | string | The remote to deploy to. Required. |
| `--env` | string | The remote's environment. |
| `--publish` | boolean | Publish what it applies. |
| `--label` | string | A label for the run. |
| `--yes` | boolean | Don't ask before applying. |
| `--no-restart` | boolean | Apply it and stop: `crombolo restart` makes it live. |
| `--public-log` | boolean | Sign from a private repository anyway: Sigstore's public log records its name, workflow, ref and commit. |
| `--sign-with` | string | Sign it with this user key, rather than the site's own. |
| `--sign` | boolean | Sign it before sending, in GitHub Actions, for a remote that takes only signed bundles. |

**Output** (single, with `-o json`):

- `runId` (string)
- `remote` (string)
- `restarted` (boolean)
- `counts` (object)

**Fails with:** `usage`, `internal`, `auth`, `refused`, `not_found`, `unavailable`, `confirmation_required`.

**Outcomes:** `blocked`.

### `crombolo site export`

Write the site as a site package, to move it to another machine or host, or a subtree of it. Each run acts again.

```
crombolo site export [--out <out>] [--subtree <subtree>] [--only] [--with-blueprints] [--with-media] [--drafts] [--with-members] [--with-users] [--with-site-data] [--anonymise] [--name <name>] [--package-version <package-version>] [--include-content] [--allow-content-unencrypted]
```

| Argument | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--out` | string | The file to write; with --subtree, the directory. |
| `--subtree` | string[] | A subtree to export instead of the whole site; repeatable. |
| `--only` | boolean | With --subtree: the roots alone, not what is below them. |
| `--with-blueprints` | boolean | With --subtree: the blueprints of its types. |
| `--with-media` | boolean | The media files too; left out unless asked. |
| `--drafts` | boolean | Drafts too. |
| `--with-members` | boolean | Members, encrypted. |
| `--with-users` | boolean | Back-office users, encrypted. |
| `--with-site-data` | boolean | The site's and its extensions' own data, encrypted. |
| `--anonymise` | boolean | Replace every personal value as it writes. |
| `--name` | string | The package's npm name. |
| `--package-version` | string | The package's version. |
| `--include-content` | boolean | Bring property values and media files, encrypted under a passphrase. |
| `--allow-content-unencrypted` | boolean | With --include-content: write them readable. |

**Output** (single, with `-o json`):

- `out` (string)
- `package` (object)
- `counts` (object)
- `sections` (object)
- `media` (object)
- `people` (object)
- `anonymised` (integer)
- `siteData` (object)
- `bundleId` (string)
- `expected` (array of object)
- `content` (string)
- `blobs` (object)

**Fails with:** `usage`, `internal`, `not_found`, `refused`, `auth`, `io`.

### `crombolo pull`

A copy of a remote environment: started here, or replacing this site. Each run acts again.

```
crombolo pull [<remote>] [--env <env>] [--full] [--yes] [--no-media] [--media-info-only] [--lazy-media] [--timeout <timeout>] [--backup-taken]
```

| Argument | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `remote` | string | The remote; the only one, when there is one. |
| `--env` | string | The environment to pull. |
| `--full` | boolean | A full copy, people included: needs the permission for it. |
| `--yes` | boolean | Replace this site without asking. |
| `--no-media` | boolean | Leave the media files out. |
| `--media-info-only` | boolean | Fetch media files one at a time, only what changed. |
| `--lazy-media` | boolean | Fetch each media file the first time it is asked for. |
| `--timeout` | integer | Seconds to wait for the remote before giving up. Default `1800`. |
| `--backup-taken` | boolean | A backup was taken another way: Postgres needs this, or CROMBOLO_PG_DUMP. |

**Output** (single, with `-o json`):

- `environment` (string)
- `size` (integer)
- `anonymised` (boolean)
- `started` (boolean)
- `runId` (string)
- `media` (object)
- `serving` (object)

**Fails with:** `usage`, `internal`, `auth`, `not_found`, `refused`, `timeout`, `unavailable`, `confirmation_required`.

### `crombolo push`

Replace a remote environment with this site. Each run acts again.

| `--timeout` | integer | Seconds to wait for the remote before giving up. Default `1800`. |
| `--no-browser` | boolean | Don't open an approval page. |

**Output** (single, with `-o json`):

- `environment` (string)
- `check` (object)

**Fails with:** `usage`, `internal`, `auth`, `not_found`, `refused`, `timeout`, `unavailable`, `confirmation_required`.

| `--stdin` | boolean | Read the new password from stdin. |

**Output** (single, with `-o json`):

- `id` (string)
- `email` (string)
- `password` (string)

**Fails with:** `usage`, `internal`, `not_found`, `refused`.

### `crombolo users unlock`

Clear a user's lockout and failed sign-ins. Safe to run again: a second run changes nothing more.

```
crombolo users unlock <user>
```

| Argument | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `user` | string | Their e-mail address or username. Required. |

**Output** (single, with `-o json`):

- `id` (string)
- `email` (string)
- `state` (string)
- `changed` (boolean)

**Fails with:** `usage`, `internal`, `not_found`, `refused`.

### `crombolo admin reset-password`

Reset the administrator's password and print it. Each run acts again.

```
crombolo admin reset-password [--stdin]
```

| Argument | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--stdin` | boolean | Read the new password from stdin. |

**Output** (single, with `-o json`):

- `login` (string)
- `password` (string)

**Fails with:** `usage`, `internal`, `not_found`.

### `crombolo api-client rotate`

Issue a new secret for the API client, and print it once. Each run acts again.

```
crombolo api-client rotate [--client <client>]
```

| Argument | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--client` | string | The client id; CROMBOLO_API_CLIENT_ID when not given. |

**Output** (single, with `-o json`):

- `client` (string)
- `secret` (string)

**Fails with:** `usage`, `internal`, `not_found`.

### `crombolo audit list`

The audit log, newest first, a page at a time. Changes nothing.

```
crombolo audit list [--since <since>] [--until <until>] [--user <user>] [--category <category>] [--action <action>] [--entity <entity>] [--remote <remote>] [--env <env>] [--limit <limit>] [--before <before>]
```

| Argument | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--since` | string | Entries at or after this time. |
| `--until` | string | Entries before this time. |
| `--user` | string | One person, by e-mail, login or key; a login with no account finds its failed sign-ins. |
| `--category` | string | One kind of change. One of `content`, `media`, `member`, `schema`, `settings`, `user`, `permission`, `sign-in`, `system`. |
| `--action` | string | One action, such as Publish or SignIn. |
| `--entity` | string | What one item had done to it. |
| `--remote` | string | Read a hosted site through this remote, signed in as you. |
| `--env` | string | The remote's environment. |
| `--limit` | integer | How many on a page. Default `50`. |
| `--before` | string | The page after this cursor. |

**Output** (bounded, with `-o json`):

- `items` (array of object)
  - `id` (integer)
  - `occurredAt` (string)
  - `category` (string)
  - `action` (string)
  - `source` (string)
  - `user` (object)
    - `key` (string)
    - `name` (string)
  - `item` (object)
    - `type` (string)
    - `key` (string)
    - `name` (string)
  - `ipAddress` (string)
  - `forwardedFor` (string)
  - `detail` (string)
- `next` (integer)
- `truncated` (boolean)

**Fails with:** `usage`, `internal`, `not_found`, `refused`.

### `crombolo audit stream`

The audit log as NDJSON, oldest first; --follow keeps it coming. Changes nothing.

```
crombolo audit stream [--since <since>] [--until <until>] [--user <user>] [--category <category>] [--action <action>] [--entity <entity>] [--remote <remote>] [--env <env>] [--after <after>] [--follow] [--interval <interval>]
```

| Argument | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--since` | string | Entries at or after this time. |
| `--until` | string | Entries before this time. |
| `--user` | string | One person, by e-mail, login or key; a login with no account finds its failed sign-ins. |
| `--category` | string | One kind of change. One of `content`, `media`, `member`, `schema`, `settings`, `user`, `permission`, `sign-in`, `system`. |
| `--action` | string | One action, such as Publish or SignIn. |
| `--entity` | string | What one item had done to it. |
| `--remote` | string | Read a hosted site through this remote, signed in as you. |
| `--env` | string | The remote's environment. |
| `--after` | integer | Carry on after this entry id. Default `0`. |
| `--follow` | boolean | Keep reading new entries until stopped. |
| `--interval` | integer | Seconds between reads with --follow. Default `5`. |

**Output:** stream.

**Fails with:** `usage`, `internal`, `not_found`, `refused`.

## Operations

Caches, the search index, maintenance pauses, outgoing changes, upgrades and restarts.

### `crombolo cache rebuild`

Rebuild the published cache on every node of the site. Safe to run again: a second run changes nothing more.

```
crombolo cache rebuild [--wait <wait>]
```

| Argument | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--wait` | integer | Seconds to wait for every node to rebuild; 0 does not wait. Default `30`. |

**Output** (single, with `-o json`):

- `instruction` (integer)
- `checkpoint` (integer)
- `nodes` (array of string)
- `behind` (array of string)

**Fails with:** `usage`, `internal`.

### `crombolo index list`

The search indexes: what each holds, and what is waiting to be indexed. Changes nothing.

```
crombolo index list
```

**Output** (bounded, with `-o json`):

- `name` (string)
- `documents` (integer)
- `fields` (integer)
- `pending` (integer)
- `healthy` (boolean)

**Fails with:** `usage`, `internal`.

### `crombolo index rebuild`

Index every item again, for every node: the index is in the database. Safe to run again: a second run changes nothing more.

```
crombolo index rebuild [<index>] [--queue-only]
```

| Argument | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `index` | string | One index; both when not given. One of `InternalIndex`, `MembersIndex`. |
| `--queue-only` | boolean | Queue everything, and let the site index it. |

**Output** (single, with `-o json`):

- `indexes` (array of string)
- `indexed` (integer)
- `queued` (boolean)

**Fails with:** `usage`, `internal`.

### `crombolo maintenance pause`

Refuse every editor's save, on every node, until resumed. Safe to run again: a second run changes nothing more.

```
crombolo maintenance pause [--reason <reason>]
```

| Argument | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--reason` | string | What editors are told. |

**Output** (single, with `-o json`):

- `paused` (boolean)
- `reason` (string)

**Fails with:** `usage`, `internal`.

### `crombolo maintenance resume`

Let editors save again. Safe to run again: a second run changes nothing more.

```
crombolo maintenance resume
```

**Output** (single, with `-o json`):

- `paused` (boolean)

**Fails with:** `usage`, `internal`.

### `crombolo maintenance status`

Whether editing is paused, by whom and why. Changes nothing.

```
crombolo maintenance status
```

**Output** (single, with `-o json`):

- `paused` (object)
  - `at` (string)
  - `by` (string)
  - `reason` (string)

**Fails with:** `usage`, `internal`.

### `crombolo events failed`

What gave up going out, and why. Changes nothing.

```
crombolo events failed [--limit <limit>]
```

| Argument | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--limit` | integer | How many of each to list. Default `50`. |

**Output** (bounded, with `-o json`):

- `items` (array of object)
  - `queue` (string)
  - `id` (string)
  - `what` (string)
  - `error` (string)

**Fails with:** `usage`, `internal`.

### `crombolo events retry`

Send failed changes, webhooks or e-mails again. Safe to run again: a second run changes nothing more.

```
crombolo events retry [<id>] [--all]
```

| Argument | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | The failed item to send again. |
| `--all` | boolean | Every failed item. |

**Output** (bounded, with `-o json`):

- `retried` (integer)

**Fails with:** `usage`, `internal`, `not_found`.

### `crombolo events status`

What is waiting to go out to webhooks and e-mail, and what failed. Changes nothing.

```
crombolo events status
```

**Output** (bounded, with `-o json`):

- `queues` (array of object)
  - `name` (string)
  - `pending` (integer)
  - `running` (integer)
  - `failed` (integer)
  - `oldestPending` (string)

**Fails with:** `usage`, `internal`.

### `crombolo upgrade`

Back up, apply pending framework migrations, cut over, and record them. Safe to run again: a second run changes nothing more.

```
crombolo upgrade [--plan] [--force <force>] [--set <set>] [--backup-taken]
```

| Argument | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--plan` | boolean | Print the DDL pending framework migrations would run, and stop. |
| `--force` | string | Go on over outstanding findings, saying why. |
| `--set` | string[] | A value for a new mandatory property: <type>.<property>=<value>. |
| `--backup-taken` | boolean | A backup was taken another way: Postgres needs this, or CROMBOLO_PG_DUMP. |

**Output** (single, with `-o json`):

- `action` (string)
- `changed` (boolean)
- `backup` (string)
- `frameworkApplied` (array of string)
- `bundlesApplied` (array of object)
- `schema` (object)
- `plan` (object)

**Fails with:** `usage`, `internal`, `refused`.

### `crombolo upgrade check`

What the deployed definitions would do to this database's data. Safe to run again: a second run changes nothing more.

```
crombolo upgrade check [--fix] [--set <set>] [--backup-taken]
```

| Argument | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--fix` | boolean | Back up, then apply the additive part and every conversion early. |
| `--set` | string[] | A value for a new mandatory property: <type>.<property>=<value>. |
| `--backup-taken` | boolean | A backup was taken another way: Postgres needs this, or CROMBOLO_PG_DUMP. |

**Output** (single, with `-o json`):

- `classification` (string)
- `findings` (array of object)
- `blocking` (boolean)
- `applied` (array of string)
- `backup` (string)

**Fails with:** `usage`, `internal`.

**Outcomes:** `blocked`.

### `crombolo upgrade ledger`

Print migration_history: every migration, sync and import applied here. Changes nothing.

```
crombolo upgrade ledger [--limit <limit>] [--offset <offset>] [--fields <fields>]
```

| Argument | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--limit` | integer | How many to list. Default `1000`. |
| `--offset` | integer | How many to skip first. Default `0`. |
| `--fields` | string | Only these fields of each item, comma-separated. |

**Output** (unbounded, with `-o json`):

- `id` (integer)
- `name` (string)
- `kind` (string)
- `appliedAt` (string)
- `durationMs` (integer)
- `appliedBy` (string)
- `bundle` (string)
- `note` (string)

**Fails with:** `usage`, `internal`.

### `crombolo upgrade schema`

Rewrite every schema/ file canonically. Safe to run again: a second run changes nothing more.

```
crombolo upgrade schema
```

**Output** (bounded, with `-o json`):

- `wrote` (array of string)

**Fails with:** `usage`, `internal`, `not_found`, `refused`.

### `crombolo restart`

Restart the site, so code installed since it started runs. Each run acts again.

```
crombolo restart [--remote <remote>] [--env <env>]
```

| Argument | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--remote` | string | Restart this remote instead. |
| `--env` | string | With --remote: the remote's environment. |

**Output** (single, with `-o json`):

- `restarted` (boolean)
- `remote` (string)

**Fails with:** `usage`, `internal`, `refused`, `unavailable`, `auth`, `not_found`.

## Exit codes

| Code | Kind | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `internal` | Something unexpected went wrong. |
| 2 | `usage` | The arguments are wrong: an unknown command or flag, or one missing. |
| 3 | `timeout` | Gave up waiting. A remote job carries on at the remote. |
| 4 | `auth` | Not signed in, the sign-in has lapsed, or a passphrase is missing or wrong. |
| 5 | `not_found` | No such remote, environment, page, run, bundle, file or account. |
| 6 | `conflict` | Someone else is changing it, or it exists with a different value. |
| 7 | `confirmation_required` | It would have asked first, and there is no terminal to ask on. |
| 8 | `refused` | The site or the remote said no: findings outstanding, a permission, a protected environment. |
| 9 | `unavailable` | The database or the remote could not be reached. |
| 10 | `io` | A file could not be read or written. |
| 20 | `problems_found` | The check found problems: `status`, `types check`, `components check`. |
| 21 | `blocked` | Something must be resolved by a person first: `site apply --dry-run`, `upgrade check`. |
| 130 | `interrupted` | Stopped by a signal. |
